changelog: The update's details no longer warn that the plugin is untested on a newer point release of the WordPress it was tested with, such as 7.1.4 when it was tested on 7.1, and Dashboard > Updates no longer reads "Unknown" there. A newer WordPress, such as 7.2, still shows the warning.
Changelog lines in the update's details show exactly as written. A line that spelled out a character code showed the character instead.
